output_structure.damage_type: The damage visible in this crop from a rental-car walkaround video. One of: scratch, dent, glass-damage, paint_chip, dirt, missing-part, stain, none
output_structure.sub_type: Short specific description, e.g. 'clear-coat scratch', 'door ding', 'curb rash'
output_structure.approx_size_cm: Approximate longest dimension in centimeters as a number, judged relative to visible car features (door handles ~10cm, wheels ~45cm)
output_structure.affected_part: The car part in view, e.g. 'front-left door', 'rear bumper', 'driver-side rear quarter panel'
output_structure.paint_broken: true or false — does the damage break through the paint to primer or metal
output_structure.pre_existing_indicators: Signs this is OLD damage (rust in the scratch, dirt accumulated in the dent, faded edges), or 'none'
output_structure.is_false_positive: true or false — true if this crop shows NO real damage: a reflection, glare, shadow, water drop, or sticker was mistaken for damage. Judge skeptically.
output_structure.confidence_note: One sentence on how confident this assessment is and why
